plan.why: Bea Mendez Gandica leads Nuevo Foundation, a nonprofit with a large global impact teaching coding, aligning with Henry's interest in builder communities around AI and developer tools. Meeting her can open pathways to collaborations on AI-driven educational initiatives and insights into improving developer experience, which Henry wants to explore at GitHub Universe.
angles: Mention his work building entertainment IP with AI at Unicorn Studios and his current projects Animori and Metacomica that combine AI, anime, and comics to connect with Bea's founder background and innovation focus.
Relate his interest in AI agents and developer tools to Bea's session on turning team workflows into GitHub Copilot CLI skills, showing shared enthusiasm for improving developer experience.

Reference his participation in AI and developer community events like the AI Infra Summit and his goal to meet builders working on AI agents, creator tools, and dev storytelling at the conference to find common ground.
openers: Hi Bea, I’m Henry Finn from Unicorn Studios in San Francisco. I’m fascinated by how you’re leveraging coding education through Nuevo Foundation and would love to hear how you think AI could enhance developer experience.

Hello Bea, I saw your session about GitHub Copilot CLI skills and am curious, how do you see AI shaping the future of coding workshops and educational outreach? I build AI-driven creative IP and always look to learn from leaders in developer tools.
plan.followUp: Thanks so much for the great conversation today, Bea. I’m excited about the possibilities of blending AI-powered creator tools with educational programs like Nuevo Foundation. Would love to explore ways we could collaborate or share resources.
